## Checklist

- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass locally
- [ ] New or changed UI text has an entry in `lib/i18n/en.ts` (the coverage test enforces it)
- [ ] No number or saving claim in the docs without a source or a reproducible measurement
- [ ] Agents still receive English only; nothing sends Arabic to an agent
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, personal paths or confidential prompts in the diff
- [ ] Docs updated where behaviour changed (see "Documentation map" in `CONTRIBUTING.md`)
